subject: Post-deploy product-use carveouts + redline roadmap
messages:
From: Dana Park <dana.park@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@bluepeakhealth.com>, procurement@bluepeakhealth.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood MSA redline: product-use carveouts & post-deploy restrictions

Rishi —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the MSA. Our legal team reviewed the initial draft and has a few high-level asks related to post-deployment product use and training:

- BluePeak needs explicit carveouts permitting internal analytics and model evaluation using customer outputs for debugging (non-production).
- We cannot accept broad "training" rights that would allow model retraining on PII or PHI; any training must be on sanitized, opt-in datasets.
- We need a clause that prevents downstream use of BluePeak outputs to build competing clinical decision products for five years.

I've attached a redline (BluePeak_MSA_redline_v2.docx) and a short matrix that maps our asks to suggested clause language. Can we get Redwood's view on:

1) Whether you can limit training to opt-in/sanitized data and exclude PHI by default;
2) If Redwood can add a post-deploy gating control (e.g., feature flag + audit log) that prevents model snapshots from being exported for retraining without an explicit contract amendment;
3) Proposed timeline to resolve these redlines (we're aiming for signature within three weeks).

Appreciate any detail you can provide — this will help our procurement team finalize the order form.

Best,
Dana Park
Head of Product Ops, BluePeak Health
Dana.Park@bluepeakhealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: BluePeak_MSA_redline_v2.docx (redline), post_deploy_carveouts_matrix.xlsx (mapping)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Dana Park <dana.park@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA redline: product-use carveouts & post-deploy restrictions

Dana —

Thanks for the clear summary and the materials. Quick responses to your three items below; Laura and Kim are on the thread to confirm legal/product constraints.

1) Training on PHI/PII: Redwood will not use identifiable PHI/PII from customer traffic for model retraining without an explicit opt-in and documented sanitization workflow. We can add a contractual commitment that default data handling is "no-training" and that any training requires a separate Data Use Addendum with sampling and sanitization controls.

2) Post-deploy export gating: Product-wise we can provide a technical control that prevents export of model snapshots and KV cache dumps unless a customer-admin toggle is enabled and a signed contract amendment is present. We'll include audit logs and an approval workflow. Note that this gating adds latency to any emergency snapshot export process — Kim can advise on the operational trade-offs.

3) Timeline: We can aim to close major redlines in two weeks if the core principles above are accepted. Legal redlines that require new PS (Professional Services) work (e.g., on-prem adaptions for audited pipelines) may add ops time.

Proposed next step: Laura, could you draft bullet language to insert into the MSA that covers (a) "no-training-by-default on customer traffic", (b) the export-gating workflow, and (c) a non-compete-esque downstream-use restriction scoped to "clinical decision support features derived from BluePeak outputs" for a defined term.

Dana — once Laura has language, happy to run a quick 30-min sync with you and procurement to align on acceptance criteria and timeline.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0122
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Dana Park <dana.park@bluepeakhealth.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 14:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA redline: product-use carveouts & post-deploy restrictions

Dana / Rishi —

I've drafted proposed language below; I've kept it tight to avoid creating open-ended obligations. Please treat this as a conversation starter — happy to iterate with BluePeak counsel.

--- Proposed MSA insert (redline ready):
1) Customer Data and Training. Unless Customer provides an explicit written Data Use Addendum, Redwood shall not use Customer Content or Customer Outputs to train, fine-tune, or improve any models that are made available to third parties or used in Redwood's public offerings. Any training that Customer opts-in to must exclude unredacted PHI/PII and must be documented in the Data Use Addendum which shall include sample selection, redaction, and retention policies.

2) Export and Snapshot Control. Redwood will implement an export-gating control for model artifacts and KV cache snapshots associated with Customer deployments. Exports will require (i) an authenticated customer-admin enablement toggle, (ii) a documented change request submitted to Redwood, and (iii) execution of a written amendment authorizing the export. All export actions will be logged and retained in audit logs for a minimum of 3 years.

3) Downstream Use Limitation. Redwood will not use Customer Outputs to create or market a product that is substantively similar to Customer's core clinical decision support features for a period of three (3) years following termination of the Agreement, provided that Customer notifies Redwood in writing of the specific outputs at issue. This limitation is limited to outputs generated by Customer Content and does not restrict internal research on anonymized, aggregated datasets.

Operational notes / open items:
- The export gating (2) will be available for Dedicated and Private deployments at GA; for Hosted customers we can offer the toggle plus audit logs and an extended review SLA.
- We need to confirm retention for audit logs with Security (default proposal: 3 years).
- Kim: can you confirm whether snapshot exports for emergency debugging (e.g., P0 incident) can be expedited under an approved emergency process? If so, we should add a clause describing the expedited path.

If BluePeak agrees in principle, I'll prepare a tracked-change redline to the MSA and the short addendum language for the Order Form.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Associate General Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Dana Park <dana.park@bluepeakhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Amit Shah <amit.shah@bluepeakhealth.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, procurement@bluepeakhealth.com
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 14:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA redline: product-use carveouts & post-deploy restrictions

Rishi / Laura —

Appreciate the rapid and detailed responses — this is helpful and much closer to what we need. A few follow-ups from our side after an internal review:

- The three-year downstream limitation looks reasonable but we need a tighter definition of "substantively similar"; we'll propose language that ties similarity to a closed set of clinical modules (we'll attach that by EOD Monday).
- The export gating + audit logs is acceptable. We'd like the audit logs to surface export requester identity (name and role) and the full change request so our compliance team can close their checklists.
- Emergency export process: we can accept an expedited path if that path requires a documented emergency approval chain (two BluePeak sign-offs + Redwood on-call). Please include SLA expectations for an expedited export (e.g., <24 hours for critical incidents).

Procurement: once Laura posts the tracked redline, we'll circulate internally and aim to finalize within the three-week window. 

Next steps:
1) Laura: tracked redline to MSA + a short Data Use Addendum template.
2) Kim: brief note on operational impact of the gating and expected timelines for engineering implementation.
3) Rishi: schedule 30-min sync with BluePeak procurement and product ops for Tuesday 1/20 10:00 PT (proposed).

Thanks again — will follow up with our proposed "substantively similar" language soon.

Best,
Dana
Head of Product Ops, BluePeak Health

> Attachment references: BluePeak_MSA_redline_v2.docx, post_deploy_carveouts_matrix.xlsx
